components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Conversion CTA for Add to Cart, Checkout, and Pay Now.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-block-size: 3rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem; border: none; border-radius: 999rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5a623, #ff9e00); color: #04101c; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1rem 2.5rem rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.22); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1.35rem 2.8rem rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.32); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5a623; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions like Clear Cart, View Details, or Apply.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-block-size: 2.8rem; padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.25); border-radius: 999rem; background: rgba(18, 32, 56, 0.75); color: #f1f7ff; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(25, 45, 80, 0.85); border-color: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5a623; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Catalog Card
components.description: Standard game tile with thumbnail, title, price, and CTA.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; padding: 1.25rem; border-radius: 1.2rem; background: rgba(13, 10, 26, 0.88); border: 1px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.14); color: #f1f7ff; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1rem 2.5rem rgba(2, 7, 15, 0.3); } .ds-card-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 999rem; background: rgba(0, 255, 179, 0.15); color: #00ffb3; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; color: #f1f7ff; } .ds-card-price { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; color: #f5a623; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; } .ds-card-orig { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #8293ad; text-decoration: line-through; margin-left: 0.4rem; }

narrative.overview: Games Habibi merges the high-energy thrill of midnight gaming arcades with a modern, high-trust digital storefront. The aesthetic embraces deep atmospheric voids (#0d0a1a) illuminated by amber (#f5a623) and electric violet (#7b2fff) accents, balancing youthful gaming enthusiasm with the clarity required for financial transactions.
keyCharacteristics: Atmospheric Gaming Dark: Deep indigo-tinted void backdrop with warm amber action highlights.
Punchy Headline Stacks: Tall, condensed display titles paired with monospaced metadata badges.
Frictionless Action Rails: High-visibility pill CTAs for adding to cart and triggering instant UPI QR payments.

rules.name: The 10% Amber Rule
rules.body: The primary amber (#f5a623) is reserved for direct conversion actions (Add to Cart, Checkout, Pay Now). It should never be used as large background fills or continuous decorative borders.

rules.name: The Readable Contrast Rule
rules.body: Never place Starlight White (#f1f7ff) or Slate Blue (#b0bfd6) text directly over glowing amber (#f5a623) or light ambient gradients; buttons on amber must use deep dark ink (#04101c) to maintain WCAG AA compliance.

rules.name: The Natural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Prohibit zero-offset colored glow halos around text and containers. Use natural Y-offset directional shadows with subtle opacity.

dos: Do maintain a strict 4.5:1 text-to-background contrast ratio on all buttons and labels.
Do respect user preferences with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) by calming infinite marquee and ambient animations.
Do provide distinct, high-contrast :focus-visible indicators on all interactive buttons and form inputs.
Do preserve minimum 44px tap targets for mobile checkout.
donts: Don't use light text over light yellow or amber gradient fills.
Don't nest card containers inside other cards, creating visual clutter.
Don't use zero-offset colored blur halos ("dark-glow") as primary design elements.
Don't let child text content touch the outer border box without at least 12px container inset padding.
